pause-control.description: --pause/--unpause control paths (issue #263). Each case saves `record` (with the case's `options`, `status` and `exitCode` merged in), runs the action against the in-memory docker and compares the normalized result: output (parsed when json), error, docker argv in call order, the calls made without a timeout, the final docker state and the saved record. ISO-8601 timestamps are replaced by <timestamp>. Regenerate the expectations with `node experiments/issue-263/pause-golden.js --write`.
pause-control.docker: In-memory docker in state running|paused|exited|removed. removed: every call except rm fails with 'Error response from daemon: No such container: <name>'. inspect -f '{{.State.Status}} {{.State.Paused}}' prints '<state> <state==paused>'; -f '{{.State.Status}}' prints '<state>'; -f '{{.Id}} {{.State.Pid}}' prints 'abc263def 4242' while running or paused, else 'abc263def 0'. pause succeeds only when running (-> paused), else fails 'container <name> is not running'; unpause succeeds only when paused (-> running), else fails 'container <name> is not paused'. Anything else succeeds with no output.
